newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank syndicate loans $124 mln for power project.
newsitem.headline: Bank syndicate loans $124 mln for power project.

text.p: A Shanghai Sino-foreign power project has received $124 million in loans from a syndicate of nine foreign banks led by the Standard Chartered Bank, the Liberation Daily said on Wednesday.
The Shanghai Zhadian Gas Turbine Power Generation Company is the first long-term, non-guaranteed commercially financed power project in China, the newspaper said.
The power station, due to go into operation in the next month or so, has four 100 MW gas turbine generators.
Shanghai's first Sino-foreign power project, 30 percent of its equity is held by GE Capital Services' Structured Finance Group, a subsidiary of General Electric, it said.
The Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company has the remaining 70 percent.
